description: This file implements a plugin class for creating EFI boot partitions within the 'wic' build system. It includes methods for configuring bootloaders (GRUB 2 and systemd-boot), preparing partitions, and handling EFI-specific boot files and images.

classes.name: BootimgEFIPlugin
classes.description: Defines a plugin class for generating EFI boot partitions supporting various bootloaders and EFI file handling within the 'wic' build system.

methods.name: do_configure_grubefi(cls, hdddir, creator, cr_workdir, source_params)
methods.description: Creates a GRUB EFI configuration file, optionally incorporating custom configs and initrds.

methods.name: do_configure_systemdboot(cls, hdddir, creator, cr_workdir, source_params)
methods.description: Creates a systemd-boot configuration, supporting custom configs and initrds.

methods.name: do_configure_partition(cls, part, source_params, creator, cr_workdir, oe_builddir, bootimg_dir, kernel_dir, native_sysroot)
methods.description: Configures the EFI partition with bootloader files based on the specified loader type.

methods.name: do_prepare_partition(cls, part, source_params, creator, cr_workdir, oe_builddir, bootimg_dir, kernel_dir, rootfs_dir, native_sysroot)
methods.description: Prepares and populates an EFI boot partition, including creating EFI images, copying files, and setting up boot entries.
